name: Progress Street
description: A heartfelt, 1980s-inspired AOR and stadium synth-rock album from The Stardust Engine, recorded in 2004 at their home on Progress Street NW in Blacksburg, Virginia. Making the full-blooded 1980s melodic rock record that Apex Records never let them make in 1987, Progress Street celebrates collegiate roots, upright pianos, second-hand 1984 synthesizers, Route 1 transit runs, and unbreakable family unity—serving as the band's final studio release before exhaustion forced them into their Burnout Hiatus.
